power_domains_summary.Vcc: Core supply. Typical 3.3 V (legacy) or 1.8 V (modern); see Section 2.10 for ranges.
power_domains_summary.VccQ: I/O supply, separate from Vcc. Typical 3.3 V (SDR legacy), 1.8 V (SDR modern / NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3), 1.2 V (advanced NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3).
power_domains_summary.VssQ: I/O ground; separate return for DQ / DQS to reduce ground bounce.
power_domains_summary.Vpp: Optional high-voltage supply for improved Program / Erase efficiency; programmable via Set Features (39h External Vpp Configuration).
power_domains_summary.VDDi: EZ NAND internal-regulator stabilizing capacitor pin (not used on raw NAND).

power_up_sequence: 1. Host applies Vcc + VccQ (and Vpp if used) per Section 2.10 ramp profile.
2. Host de-asserts WP_n LOW (write-protect engaged) and CE_n HIGH (deselected) during ramp.
3. Host waits for Vcc + VccQ within operating range plus tCRY (ramp-to-ready).
4. Host asserts CE_n LOW; issues Reset (FFh).
5. Device drives R/B_n LOW; host waits up to 5 ms (first reset) for R/B_n HIGH.
6. Host runs Discovery (Read ID 90h address 20h → 'ONFI'; Read Parameter Page ECh).
7. (NV-DDR family) Host switches data interface via Set Features (01h), then ZQ Calibration Long (F9h), then training (NV-DDR3).
8. Host de-asserts WP_n (HIGH) when ready to allow Program / Erase.
fields.staggered_power_up: Section 2.14 — For systems with many targets sharing a single Vcc / VccQ rail, host shall stagger CE_n + Reset across targets to bound inrush current.

low_power_modes_summary.Standby: CE_n HIGH while target is ready → low-power standby; ICC1.
low_power_modes_summary.Deep_power_down: Vendor-specific (Set Features) or by removing Vcc; full state loss.
low_power_modes_summary.ClockStop_NV_DDR: Host may stop CLK during NV-DDR Idle; DQS held HIGH if ODT enabled.
low_power_modes_summary.Vpp_off: Set Features (39h) disables external Vpp when Program / Erase efficiency not required.
low_power_modes_summary.OdT_Deselected: NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 — ODT off on deselected LUNs (matrix termination via E2h).

rows: Vendor-specific; ICC3; higher due to charge-pump
Vendor-specific; ICC4; highest due to high-voltage erase
Vendor-specific; higher than SDR due to higher MT/s

fields.icc_measurement_methodology: Appendix D of ONFI 4.1 defines a normative ICC measurement methodology for cross-vendor comparison: specific traffic patterns, average vs peak measurement windows, ambient temperature point.
fields.external_vpp_configuration: Set Features (39h) optionally enables external Vpp supply (typ. 12 V) to enhance Program / Erase efficiency. Devices not using Vpp shall tie the pin to Vss (per vendor instruction).

fxe_power_management_register_set.Vpp_enable: Optional via Set Features (39h External Vpp Configuration).
fxe_power_management_register_set.Volume_low_power: Per-volume power state during CE_n pin reduction operation (Set Features 58h).
fxe_power_management_register_set.EZ_NAND_power: Set Features (80h-81h EZ NAND control) for in-package controller power state.

fields.notes: Section 2.10 (Recommended DC Operating Conditions) and Section 2.14 (Staggered Power-up) are normative for power-up. Section 2.13 (Calculating Pin Capacitance) constrains driver / receiver capacitance budgets. Section 4.10 (Capacitance) tightens limits for NV-DDR family. Power consumption is vendor-specific and reported in vendor datasheets — ONFI standardizes the measurement methodology (Appendix D) rather than the absolute numbers.
